author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Productivity gain of AI is real.  For some tasks, it is not 30%, not 3x, not even 10x, more like 100x

I have a task that took the best senior engineer 3 months to finish merely 2 years ago.

My AI agent finished it in less than 24 hours, burnt only $650 tokens (public API rate)
